text:
Amelia: Heads up — saw a spike in inbound claim latency this morning, ~22% of leads >30s before owner assigned. HubSpot -> SF handoff timing looks off. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Raj: Yep, same. Correlates with enrichment job lag — enrichment_service queue spiked around 09:12 and retries piled up. Pasting small log sample in case it helps.
Raj: ```
09:12:03 enrichment-worker[3] WARN retrying lead 4882 (ttl=3s)
09:12:07 router INFO routing lead 4882 -> round_robin (attempt=2)
09:12:35 hs-webhook ERROR delivery timeout 504
```
Sophia: Can we fallback to the overflow pool earlier? Right now round-robin waits the full 45s and then times out, which pushes things into manual queue. Overflow pool at least keeps SDRs engaged.
Iona: Current HubSpot workflow has claim_timeout=45s and a gating condition: enrichment_status == "complete". That's the culprit when enrichment spikes.
Mike-Sales: Customers flagged SLA escalations this morning — escalation emails fired for leads that were actually in-flight with enrichment. We should avoid false negatives. :grimacing:
Amelia: Proposal: set HS claim_timeout=15s, add a heartbeat probe from the router to enrichment (every 3s) so we know in-flight state, and short-circuit to overflow pool after 2 failed attempts. Also emit lead.transfer.latency with routing_path tag.
Raj: +1. Also add a HubSpot custom property 'routing_attempts' and increment on each try. That lets analytics and oncall distinguish retries from stuck. Also shuffle the round-robin seed each hour to avoid owner bias.
Sophia: Sounds good. One ask: feature-flag the change so we can rollback if misassignments increase.
Iona: I'll open a PR with the workflow JSON + flag gating. Canary plan: 1 hour in staging -> 1-hour canary in prod limited to 10% of traffic, monitor unassigned_count and claimant_rate. Alert if unassigned_count rises by >5% vs baseline.
DevOpsBot: Canary deployment scheduled for 10:30. Monitoring hooks: leads.router.latency, hs.webhook.errors, enrichment.queue_depth. Notifications will post to #marketing and #eng-oncall.
Amelia: Runbook updates: if >10% unassigned after 1h, toggle bypass_enrichment flag (temporary) and DM @oncall-sales. Also pause SLA escalation emails during canary.
Mike-Sales: I'll pause SLA escalation emails for the next 2 hours while we test. Thanks.
Raj: Quick config diff I plan to push in the PR (explicit for the workflow):
Raj: ```json
{
  "claim_timeout": 15,
  "fallback": { "type": "overflow_pool", "after_attempts": 2 },
  "heartbeat_interval_sec": 3,
  "record_property": "routing_attempts"
}
```
Sophia: Rollback plan noted. If any misassignment spikes, flip flag and revert claim_timeout. Keep the canary small.
Amelia: Great — let's reconvene at 11:30 for post-canary check. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
